items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] See, he went to New York with Reese Knight and Southern.

ctx.x: That's Poissy Gabriel. Lawrence DeRux. Irvin DeRux. That's Kazmaier Paul. He's a guitar player. He's not been playing for a year.
See, he went to New York with Reese Knight and Southern.

Well, that's what made me think they had 14. Cary, you see, he should have been, no, that's true. That's only three sacks. He's sacks. He's a sacks player. And he was a tenor player. This boy is very good at musicians. He hadn't planned.
